tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: rich-black
tokens.usage: Sophistication, formality, the backdrop of fine dining. Used as background on `body`; text on `.badge-gold`, `.badge-cream`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Premium linens, pristine china, understated elegance. Used as text on `body`, `.nav-menu a`, `.hero h1`. 17.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: burgundy
tokens.usage: Aged wine, culinary passion, warmth without casualness. Used as border on `.hero`, `.section-header`, `.content-card`; background on `tbody tr:hover`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Michelin stars, excellence, prestigious achievement. Used as text on `.logo`, `.logo::before`, `.nav-menu a:hover, .nav-menu a:focus`; border on `.nav-menu a:hover, .nav-menu a:focus`. 7.2:1 on `page-bg`.
